Overview

Kragujevac is a city in Šumadija with a population of 179,000. An industrial city in central Serbia, historically the first capital of modern Serbia and home to the Zastava automotive plant. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
